title: Physical Frictions and Digital Banking Adoption
near_miss_reason: Time-varying controls (beginning-of-month balance, monthly salary) are the sole violation in Table 2 columns 1, 2, 4, 5, which regress ATM usage distance and log ATM transactions on a single absorbing closure indicator (dum_atmclose_fav6_f or dum_atmclose_near_f) with customer and calendar-month FE, clustered by postal code (article Table 2 notes: beginning balance, monthly salary, year-month and customer fixed effects). Table 2 columns 3 and 6 and Table 4 enter both closure indicators jointly, Tables 3 and 5-9 are IV (ivreg2hdfe) and Table 10 is a count model, so those columns fail further rules. Staggered ATM closures in Singapore (DBS customers, monthly 2015-2017); DBS data are under NDA and not shipped.
near_miss_5c_note: 5c design-eligible columns: Table 2 cols 1, 2, 4, 5 (outcomes ATM usage distance and log ATM transactions). Excluded from 5c because the DBS data are not shipped.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Closures occur at different ATMs in different months of 2015-2017 (README Figure 1; Figure 4 event time), but cohort counts cannot be verified without the DBS data.
main_or_robustness: main (first stage of the IV design)
eligible_reason: The headline design is IV (ATM closures instrument usage distance). The first-stage and reduced-form regressions are staggered absorbing-closure TWFE with customer and month FE, but every column includes time-varying controls (sumbegmthbal, summthsal); Table 2 cols 3/6 and Table 4 add a second closure indicator. No column satisfies every rule; DBS data are under NDA and not shipped.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe/ivreg2hdfe/ppmlhdfe (SAS data preparation). Sample: random anonymized sample of 500,000 DBS retail customers, 2015-2017, no joint accounts, at least 6 GIRO or 1 salary credit; 5,994,130 customer-months. Table 9 uses PSM-matched samples (IV). Figure 4 plots residual event-time activity for treated vs PSM controls.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (sumbegmthbal, summthsal) in every column (sole violation; 5c design-eligible)
two closure indicators jointly (extra treatment regressor) plus time-varying controls
IV (ivreg2hdfe) or Poisson (ppmlhdfe); Table 9 PSM-matched IV

data_files_note: Only public map/population-density files for Figure 1 are shipped; DBS customer transaction data (MSpanel2_7feb22 and PSM panels) are under NDA.
data_provenance_note: README: 'The underlying proprietary and confidential data from DBS bank cannot be provided due to a Non-Disclosure Agreement'.
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, ivreg2hdfe, ppmlhdfe, psmatch2) with SAS data preparation
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Near-miss with controls as the sole violation in Table 2 cols 1, 2, 4, 5; no shipped data.
hand_check_nov4: Controls-only confirmed: article Table 2 columns 1, 2, 4, 5 report one closure indicator with Beginning Balance and Monthly Salary, year-month and customer FE, so main-text columns exist whose only violation is time-varying controls. Flag true kept; reason text rewritten so the classifier reads a single violation (other columns' restrictions described without category terms; details stay in the spec list).
